name: Aye Finance Limited
summary: Aye Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides loans to micro, small, and medium enterprises in India. The company offers a range of business loans for working capital and business expansion needs against hypothecation of working assets or against security of property to customers across manufacturing, trading, service, and allied agriculture sectors.
